International Cheese Federation Industry News Archive
This page provides an archive of industry news articles from the International Cheese Federation, written by Yuri Lee. The articles cover various economic and operational aspects of the cheese and dairy industry, including federal tariffs on imports and exports, fluctuations in market prices for cheese and whey, vulnerabilities in the supply chain due to natural disasters, and the details and deadlines of government margin-support programs for dairy producers.
